description:
Permanently delete a Sentry Metric Monitor, and its legacy metric alert and incident history if present. Connected Alerts are kept.
To pause detection instead, use update_metric_monitor. Cron jobs: find_monitors. URL checks: find_uptime_monitors.

monitorId.description: Metric Monitor ID from find_metric_monitors, not a legacy metric alert ID.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: delete_metric_monitor
title: Delete Metric Monitor
